text.p: Coca-Cola Enterprises Inc said Wednesday that all of the $115 million of convertible preferred stock outstanding at the end of first-quarter 1997 had fully converted to common stock prior to the end of April 1997.
This convertible preferred stock was originally issued for the acquisition of the Ouachita Coca-Cola Bottling Co Inc.

The conversion of the outstanding preferred stock resulted in the issuance of 2,196,510 shares of common stock (6,589,530 common shares on a split-adjusted basis) in April and eliminated the dividends associated with this preferred stock after April 28, 1997.
As of May 5, 1997, the company had 128,433,504 common shares outstanding, or 385,300,512 common shares outstanding on a split-adjusted basis.
